messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ciao! Avete la borsa a tracolla in nero?

expect.answer: Yes, the black leather shoulder bag is available at €89.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: How much is the leather backpack?

expect.answer: €129.00 (before €149.00), black, in stock.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: La borsa a tracolla marrone è disponibile?

expect.answer: Brown is sold out; black (€89.00) and cuoio (€95.00) are available.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: What colours does the men's wallet come in?

expect.answer: Black and blue, both €39.00 and available.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Avete la cintura in taglia 110?

expect.answer: Size 110 is sold out; sizes 90 and 100 are available at €35.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Do you sell silk scarves?

expect.answer: Yes, a pure silk scarf in red or blue at €35.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Quanto costa il portachiavi?

expect.answer: The leather keyring costs €12.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Do you have the canvas tote bag?

expect.answer: It is not in the shop's catalog (the canvas tote is not on sale); no price for it. Offering the leather bags instead, or saying the team can check, is fine.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Avete borse sotto i 50 euro?

expect.answer: No bag costs under €50 (the shoulder bag is €89.00, the backpack €129.00). Suggesting cheaper accessories with their real prices is fine.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Is the cuoio shoulder bag more expensive than the black one?

expect.answer: Yes: cuoio €95.00, black €89.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ma la pelle è vera?

expect.answer: Yes, genuine Italian vegetable-tanned leather, made in the shop's workshop in Sassari.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can you engrave my initials on the wallet?

expect.answer: Yes, initials up to 3 letters for free on wallets and keyrings; it adds 2 days to shipping.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Quanto costa la spedizione a Cagliari?

expect.answer: Sardinia: €5.00, free from €70.00, delivery in 1-2 days.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: How long does delivery to Milan take?

expect.answer: 2-4 days (zone Italia, €7.90, free from €99.00).

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Spedite anche in Germania?

expect.answer: Yes, zone Unione Europea: €15.00, 4-7 days, no free shipping threshold.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Do you ship to the USA?

expect.answer: No, the shop ships only within the European Union.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Da quanto è gratis la spedizione in Italia?

expect.answer: Free shipping in Italy (outside Sardinia) from €99.00; in Sardinia from €70.00.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: If I buy the leather backpack, is shipping to Rome free?

expect.answer: Yes: the backpack is €129.00, over the €99.00 free-shipping threshold for Italy.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Con che corriere spedite?

expect.answer: With a tracked courier. The shop data names no courier company, so naming one is a made-up fact.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: I live in Sassari. How much is shipping if I only buy a wallet?

expect.answer: €5.00 (the wallet is €39.00, under the €70.00 free-shipping threshold for Sardinia), 1-2 days.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Posso restituire una borsa se non mi piace?

expect.answer: Yes, free return within 14 days of delivery if unused and with the tag.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: How long do I have to return something?

expect.answer: 14 days from delivery.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Dopo il reso, quando arriva il rimborso?

expect.answer: Within 7 days of the parcel arriving back at the shop.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I return an item I bought on sale?

expect.answer: Sale items can only be exchanged, not refunded.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Il reso è gratuito?

expect.answer: Yes, returns are free within 14 days.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: I wore the belt for a week. Can I still return it?

expect.answer: Returns are only for unused items with the tag, so a worn belt can't be returned; offering the team for special cases is fine.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Posso pagare con la carta?

expect.answer: No, only cash on delivery to the courier.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Do you accept PayPal?

expect.answer: No, the only payment method is cash on delivery.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Come si paga?

expect.answer: Cash on delivery: you pay the courier in cash.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I pay in instalments?

expect.answer: No, payment is cash on delivery only.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Il contrassegno costa qualcosa in più?

expect.answer: The shop data doesn't say whether cash on delivery has a fee.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Che orari fate?

expect.answer: Monday to Saturday 9:30-13:00 and 16:00-19:30, closed on Sunday.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: What's your phone number?

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Avete un negozio dove posso vedere le borse?

expect.answer: Yes, the workshop-shop in Via Esempio 1, Sassari, open Mon-Sat 9:30-13:00 and 16:00-19:30.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Are you open on Sundays?

expect.answer: No, closed on Sunday.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Fate prezzi all'ingrosso per negozi?

expect.answer: Wholesale is not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Do you have a loyalty card or a points programme?

expect.answer: Not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Riparate anche borse comprate da voi qualche anno fa?

expect.answer: Repairs are not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I get an invoice with my company's VAT number?

expect.answer: Invoices are not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Quanto pesa lo zaino in pelle?

expect.answer: The backpack's weight is not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Is the leather backpack waterproof?

expect.answer: Not in the shop data.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Avete un codice sconto per il primo ordine?

expect.answer: Discount codes are not in the shop data; the AI must not promise one.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I pick up my order at your shop instead of having it shipped?

expect.answer: Pick-up is not in the shop data (only the shop's address is).

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Il pacco è arrivato rovinato e la borsa è graffiata. Voglio parlare con qualcuno!

expect.answer: A complaint about a damaged order goes to the team.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I talk to a real person, please?

expect.answer: The customer asks for a person.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Vorrei ordinare la borsa a tracolla nera.

messages.author: ai
messages.text: Ottima scelta! Per preparare il riepilogo mi servono nome e cognome, telefono e indirizzo completo (via e numero, CAP, città, provincia).

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Giulia Prova, 333 000 0001, Via Prova 5, 07100 Sassari (SS), Italia

expect.answer: A summary: 1 black shoulder bag €89.00, shipping Sardegna free (over €70.00), total €89.00 cash on delivery, and a request to confirm. It must not say the order is confirmed.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: I'd like two blue men's wallets, delivered to Milan.

messages.author: ai
messages.text: Great! To prepare the summary I need your full name, phone number and full address (street and number, postal code, city, province).

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Marco Test, +39 333 000 0002, Via Esempio 10, 20121 Milano MI, Italy

expect.answer: A summary: 2 × blue wallet €39.00 = €78.00, shipping Italia €7.90, total €85.90 cash on delivery, and a request to confirm. Not confirmed yet.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Prendo lo zaino in pelle, spedito a Roma.

messages.author: ai
messages.text: Perfetto! Mi scrivi nome e cognome, telefono e indirizzo completo?

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Luca Prova, 333 000 0003, Via delle Prove 3, 00184 Roma RM

expect.answer: A summary: backpack €129.00, shipping free (over €99.00 for Italia), total €129.00 cash on delivery, asks to confirm.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: I want to order the brown shoulder bag.

expect.answer: Brown is sold out; offers black (€89.00) or cuoio (€95.00) instead. No order summary for brown.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Vorrei una sciarpa di seta rossa da spedire a Berlino.

messages.author: ai
messages.text: Certo! Mi servono nome e cognome, telefono e indirizzo completo con CAP e città.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Anna Test, +49 30 0000000, Teststraße 1, 10115 Berlin, Germania

expect.answer: A summary: red silk scarf €35.00, shipping Unione Europea €15.00, total €50.00 cash on delivery, asks to confirm.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Can I combine two orders into one shipment?

expect.answer: No: two separate orders are prepared and shipped separately, even to the same address.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Posso cambiare il mio ordine dopo averlo fatto?

expect.answer: Yes, within two hours of ordering, by writing to the shop; after that it can no longer be changed.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: How long is the warranty on your bags?

expect.answer: Twenty-four months for manufacturing defects; normal wear and misuse are not covered.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: La garanzia copre anche l'usura?

expect.answer: No, the warranty does not cover normal wear or misuse; it covers manufacturing defects for 24 months.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: How should I clean my leather bag?

expect.answer: A soft dry cloth, no water or solvents, a little neutral cream every six months.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Ogni quanto devo mettere la crema sulla pelle?

expect.answer: Once every six months, a small amount of neutral cream.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Is your packaging eco-friendly?

expect.answer: Products ship in a recycled cardboard box, inside a cotton bag.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Cosa succede se non sono a casa quando passa il corriere?

expect.answer: The courier tries twice; then the parcel waits at the depot for five working days and goes back to the shop.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: Potete mettere un biglietto di auguri nel pacco?

expect.answer: Yes, a free handwritten note with the message written in the order notes.

messages.author: customer
messages.text: What is the lining of the bags made of?

expect.answer: Natural cotton lining, with brass buckles.
